g.text: Ordinary removable over-clamp: same threshold duty for both floor routes
UNADOPTED central section only. Bolts outside pan; ends, fixed support, seal and walking transition remain open.
Heel 3980
Bolt 4010
Seal 4045
Upper clamp lifts completely before NORTH withdrawal.
10 mm new top level: actual walking/finish transition is not admitted.
15 mm crest
0 apron
NORTH →
Fixed lower backing ends at 4058; integral riser starts at 4060: only 2 mm nominal central separation.
Pan moves NORTH; riser moves away from fixed backing. This does not prove end-dam/capture release.
1780 mm clamp / 19 reference bolts / 97.222 mm pitch. Upper bar alone 11.671 kg.
15 N/mm catalogue-only sensitivity → seal 26.70 kN; heel 31.15 kN;
bolt tension 57.85 kN, equal share 3044.7 N before prying/pretension.
Bolts are above the selected glass/distribution stack. No unsupported anchor through those layers is assumed.
Fixed flange / heel / support back to RC −180 needs actual geometry, movement, capacity and thermal pricing.
Actual formed pan underside is not a machined seal housing. Finish, custom seal and constituent duties persist.
End X5102 / 6898 and crest 75 are authored; full apron/end intersection and closed end seals are not.
No wet-floor hole, permanent weld to renewable pan, detached apron or 37 sealed bosses is required by this sketch.
No complete threshold, air/water, walking, support, material or renewal pass follows.
